package probe_test

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	dockercontainer "github.com/moby/moby/api/types/container"
	dockerclient "github.com/moby/moby/client"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go"
)

type record struct {
	Session string
	First string
	Second string
}

func TestSharedReaper(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("REAPER_PROBE_STATE")
	var state record
	second := os.Getenv("REAPER_PROBE_PHASE") == "second"
	if second {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &state); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		select {
		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
		case <-t.Context().Done(): t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
		}
	}
	c, err := testcontainers.GenericContainer(t.Context(), testcontainers.GenericContainerRequest{
		ContainerRequest: testcontainers.ContainerRequest{
			Image: os.Getenv("REAPER_PROBE_ALPINE"), ImagePlatform: "linux/amd64",
			Cmd: []string{"sleep", "60"},
			HostConfigModifier: func(h *dockercontainer.HostConfig) {
				h.Memory = 32 << 20
				h.NanoCPUs = 250e6
			},
		}, Started: true,
	})
	if c != nil { testcontainers.CleanupContainer(t, c) }
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	client, err := testcontainers.NewDockerClientWithOpts(t.Context())
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	defer client.Close()
	containers, err := client.ContainerList(t.Context(), dockerclient.ContainerListOptions{
		Filters: make(dockerclient.Filters).
			Add("label", "org.testcontainers.sessionId="+c.SessionID()).
			Add("label", "org.testcontainers.ryuk=true"),
	})
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if len(containers.Items) != 1 { t.Fatalf("expected one session reaper: %+v", containers.Items) }
	id := containers.Items[0].ID
	if second {
		if state.Session != c.SessionID() { t.Fatal("fixture processes did not share a parent session") }
		state.Second = id
	} else {
		state = record{Session: c.SessionID(), First: id}
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, b, 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if second {
		reused := state.First == state.Second
		if reused != (os.Getenv("REAPER_EXPECT_REUSE") == "true") {
			t.Fatalf("reused=%t first=%s second=%s", reused, state.First, state.Second)
		}
		t.Logf("same parent session; reused=%t reaper=%s", reused, id)
	}
}
